name: Martin Schulz

events.place: Kolonia Zbiersk, Kalisz Powiat, Kalisz Obwód, Kalisz Voivodeship, Congress Poland
Stawiszyn, Kalisz Powiat, Warsaw Governorate, Congress Poland

notes:
Refer to LDS copy of Church marriage registry on film # 764031, record # 9.  This document was translated by Eva Kurnicka.
Refer also to LDS copy of birth record of Berta Zellmer (person #1726) which states that on the year of Berta's birth, 1870, Martin Schulz was 48 years old.  This makes his birth date (1870 - 48 = 1822) 1822 by inference and has been used in this record.  But there is a conflict with the birth record of Anna Dorothea Pfeiffer on LDS film # 758374, Record #4, which, according the interpretation by Henry Brodersen, says that "Martin Schulz of 25 years of age" was a witness.  Since the record for Anna Dorothea's birth was 1815, that would make Martin Schulz's birth year at 1790.  But this conflicts with the birthyear of Martin's wife Karoline Pfeiffer of 1831 and it is hardly likely that she would have married someone 41 years older.   Something is wrong.  Perhaps the birthyear assigned to Karoline Pfeiffer is wrong.
